content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Vaishali at Hajipur, dated 17 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Principal District & Sessions Judge, Vaishali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Principal District & Sessions Judge, Vaishali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Clerk, 1 Stenographer, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Principal District & Sessions Judge, Vaishali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Vaishali at Hajipur, by personally or through registered post, to reach by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No amount printed; remuneration governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years as per Patna High Court guidelines. Stenographer: experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Clerk: knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Peon/Orderly: capable of performing the duties of the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court. Period of engagement and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.
